Signals entry into AI data center optics, expanding TAM beyond lidar.
Targets CPO in AI data centers
Aligns with rising demand for high-bandwidth, lower-power interconnects.
Could cut power/complexity in optical links, a key AI cost driver.
Leverages existing IP; implies lower incremental investment.
Partnerships could accelerate commercialization and revenue.

This is an early-stage strategic expansion from lidar into AI data center photonics, with no customers or revenue disclosed. A signed design win, licensing deal, or revenue guidance tied to the module would turn this into a stronger catalyst.
